title: Disrupting the gathering
literal_meaning: Letting a bull into an assembly.
explanation: An orderly gathering is disturbed without need. The animal image conveys the disruption; no real release of an animal is implied.
meaning_odia: ବିନା କାରଣରେ ଏକ ସଭା ବା କାମରେ ବିଶୃଙ୍ଖଳା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବାକୁ ଏହି ରୂଢ଼ି କୁହାଯାଏ।
usage_example: Someone interrupts a useful discussion with a quarrel unrelated to it. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
